description: Estimates the costs of introducing AI, shown separately as external costs (contractor, DPIA, legal review, AI literacy training), internal staff time, licences per month and operations per month (hosting, model usage, maintenance), and the payback period in three savings scenarios. Public data with source and retrieval date: Eurostat labour costs (for internal staff time only), published licence, hosting and model price lists, the ECB exchange rate, and savings effects from four published studies. Amounts without a reliable public source are inputs; when they are missing, the result lists them and does not assume values. Also names, per country (SI, AT, DE, HR), where to check current public funding calls for digitalisation and AI; it gives no amounts and does not say whether any call is open.

country.description: ISO country code: SI, AT, DE or HR; otherwise the EU average

lang.description: Language of the result: sl, en, de or hr. Texts not yet translated are returned in English and marked in the result.

own_savings_share.description: Own estimate of the share of process time saved; replaces the study

process_hours_per_week.description: Hours per week currently spent on the process

task_type.description: Type of work, to apply the effect measured in a published study

name: estimate_ai_costs
title: Estimate AI costs and payback
